items.title: Public Storage (PSA) Completes Senior Notes Offering Tied To National Storage Deal
items.summary: Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) has completed a major senior notes offering with detailed covenant disclosures. The notes include special mandatory redemption provisions tied to the outcome of its planned acquisition of National Storage Affiliates Trust. These terms link the company’s new debt obligations directly to the completion or non completion of the pending transaction. items.title: Barclays upgrades CubeSmart, cuts Public Storage on relative valuation
items.summary: Investing.com --- Barclays upgraded CubeSmart to Overweight from Equal Weight and downgraded Public Storage to Equal Weight from Overweight, saying relative valuations now favor CubeSmart after its weaker year-to-date performance, while maintaining its Overweight rating on Extra Space Storage.
